metadata.title: Reggaeton and Bachata Album Cover Aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, sepia-toned portrait featuring an extreme close-up of a male artist against an ornate, dark-carved background with elegant script overlays.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, asymmetrical portrait of a male figure occupying the left third of the frame, set against a richly textured, dark-carved wooden throne. The entire scene is unified by a warm, desaturated sepia and gold color grade, featuring a large-scale calligraphic script across the lower half and clean geometric type in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme close-up face on the left balancing the ornate throne on the right
Flowing script typography intersecting with the subject's hand and chest
Monochromatic sepia tones creating a sense of timeless luxury
Sharp facial features contrasting with the soft, textured background grain
Geometric sans-serif secondary text providing a modern counterpoint to the script
coreInvariants: Asymmetrical composition with the subject's face cropped at the left edge
Presence of an ornate, dark-textured architectural or furniture element
Large-scale, thin-stroke calligraphic script as the primary typographic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is an extreme close-up on the left, while his hand is positioned centrally in the lower-middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and the large 'R' of the script serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the subject's face on the left, follows the curve of the script across the bottom, and ends at the upper-right text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with texture, though the upper right area is less dense to allow for secondary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and ochre tones provide the overall atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows and dark wood textures provide structural depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white or cream highlights in the typography and the subject's earring.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark throne and the light skin/text.

letterConstructionRules: Primary script features extreme flourishes and thin, elegant strokes
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, all-caps geometric forms
Script strokes vary in weight to mimic a flexible nib pen
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial 'R' has an oversized, sweeping loop that extends into the background
The 'S' features a long, horizontal tail that underlines the name
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, flowing script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Small crown icon above the secondary text
Subtle film grain and paper texture overlays

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, formal calligraphic style
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, high-contrast portrait of a man's face cropped on the left side, with his hand visible in the center. Behind him is a dark, ornate carved wooden throne. Apply a warm gold color grade and subtle film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, elegant white calligraphic script name across the bottom third. In the top right corner, add a wide-tracked geometric sans-serif title in all caps with a small crown icon above it.

verificationChecks: Is the subject's face cropped on the left edge?
Is the color palette strictly monochromatic sepia/gold?
Does the script have long, sweeping flourishes?
Is the secondary text in the top right widely tracked?

mustRedesign: Do not use standard blocky fonts for the main name
postGenerationChecks: Verify the script does not obscure the subject's eyes
Ensure the background texture is visible but not distracting
Confirm the wide tracking of the upper-right text
recipe.reuseFormula: Asymmetrical Portrait + Ornate Texture + Sepia Grade + Flourished Script = Urban Luxury Aesthetic
